units.source_text: 究竟什么事弄得他胆战心惊呢？

en.t: What on earth had frightened him so badly?

units.source_text: ……制住敌人要害之处的不就是你吗……

en.t: ...weren't you the one who had seized the enemy by his vital point...

units.source_text: 为什么不能再镇静一些，拿出观察者的风度来呢！

en.t: Why couldn't he be a little calmer and show the composure of an observer!

units.source_text: 是了，要是能够平安回去，这次体验实在有记录下来的价值。

en.t: Yes, if he could get back safely, this experience would truly be worth recording.
